changelog:
Initial release of storyboard-9grid – an advanced 9-panel movie storyboard generator for directors and visual creators.

- Converts scripts or story outlines into professional-level 9-grid visual storyboard structures.
- Each panel within a shot includes detailed, Nano Banana Pro–ready prompts (composition, lighting, scene, emotion, action, camera, etc.).
- Provides a unified GLOBAL PROMPT for style, worldbuilding, characters, and technical details, ensuring visual consistency.
- Automated breakdown of the story into storyboard nodes with clear narrative function and emotional tone.
- Optimized workflow for high consistency in style, characters, and atmosphere across all panels and shots.
